[10] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.300, sim=0.4837)
[CR CR0868 for 38.300] Reason for change: In RAN2#124, we have made following agreement for multi-DCI based Multi-TRP operation with two TA, and made following descriptions in TS 38.321. The intended behaviour, i.e., the second TA is acquired through PDCCH oredered CFRA, is an important step worth capturing in TS 38.300. NOTE: Similar descriptions to explain the way to acquire a specific TA can be found for SCell TA, LTM candidate cell TA, in Section 9.2.6. This CR intends to provide the same clarification for 2TA case. Summary of change: 9.2.6 Clarified to use random access procedure ordered by PDCCH for acquisition of the second TA. Consequences if not approved: It remains unclear how the second TA is acquired while 2 TAs are configured.
